# devbox-win: Complete LLM Technical Reference & Specification

> Project: devbox-win  
> Author: Belal Waheed  
> Repository: https://github.com/belal-waheed/devbox-win  
> Website: https://belal-waheed.github.io/devbox-win/  
> Target Platform: Microsoft Windows 11 (Build 22000+)  
> Shell: PowerShell 7.5.0+ (pwsh)  
> License: MIT  

---

## 1. System Overview

devbox-win is a native, zero-dependency declarative developer environment provisioner for Windows 11. It eliminates manual setup, ad-hoc bat files, and bloated third-party orchestration agents by leveraging native Windows 11 tools: WinGet, PowerShell 7+, and unprivileged NTFS symbolic links.

## 2. Directory Structure

## 3. CLI Command Reference

```powershell
# Standard run (uses config.yaml or interactive wizard on first run)
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/engine.ps1

# Dry-run execution (evaluates all 12 modules without disk writes)
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/engine.ps1 -DryRun

# Apply specific role preset
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/engine.ps1 -Preset belal-catppuccin
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/engine.ps1 -Preset fullstack

# Run specific individual module
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/engine.ps1 -Module editor

# Interactive First-Time Setup Wizard
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/wizard.ps1
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/wizard.ps1 -NonInteractive -OutputPath config.yaml

# Run 17-point machine health diagnostics
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/doctor.ps1

# Launch Edge companion web dashboard
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/dashboard.ps1 -Open

# Create compressed SHA256 disaster recovery snapshot
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/backup.ps1

# Restore workstation state with pre-restore snapshot guard
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/backup.ps1 -Restore "backup.zip"

# Reverse-engineer currently installed software into config.yaml
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/export.ps1 -OutputPath "exported_config.yaml"

# Two-way cross-machine Git synchronization
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/sync.ps1 -Status
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/sync.ps1 -Push
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/sync.ps1 -Pull

# Clean rollback (reverts all symlinks to original backups)
pwsh -NoProfile -File core/engine.ps1 -Uninstall
```

- 148 Automated unit tests in `tests/engine.tests.ps1`: 148 passed, 0 failed.
- 0 AST parser syntax errors across all 31 PowerShell scripts.
- Strict zero-emoji compliance across all code, logs, and docs.
